newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown pressed to hike taxes - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown pressed to hike taxes - paper.

text.p: UK's Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown is under intense pressure to significantly increase taxes his first Budget, the Times said on Monday.
A tax hike would help take the steam out of consumer spending and avert the threat of a sharp rise in interest rates later this year, the paper said.
Economists said the Budget, to be unveiled on July 2, should aim to raise up to five billion stg through higher taxes. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
